kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: How tariffs, fuel and fertilizer costs are squeezing the U.S.'s biggest apple region
wire.summary: Washington's $9 billion industry grows more than 70% of the nation's fresh apples. Farmers are being pressed by high costs, tariffs and a strong dollar that diminishes foreign purchasing power.

wire.title: The U.S. government is investigating Iranian ties to as many as 50 hacked commercial vessels
wire.summary: The attacks, if officials who spoke to NPR are correct, may be the latest example of Iranian cyberattacks against global critical infrastructure during the war with the U.S.

wire.title: Who really owns the Albanian land Jared Kushner wants to turn into a 5-star resort?
wire.summary: Albania's Prime Minister Edi Rama has vowed that Kushner's resort project will go ahead as planned. But an ongoing investigation by Albania's state prosecutor into forged land titles could halt the project.

wire.title: Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia. And, Rep. Gomez resigns amid alleged sexual misconduct
wire.summary: President Trump took credit for negotiating Jensen Huang's return as CEO of Nvidia. And, Rep. Jimmy Gomez, D-Calif., says his resignation will be effective Dec. 1.

wire.title: What should it cost to insure a home in wildfire country?
wire.summary: Some California homeowners have spent thousands making their homes safer from wildfires. Yet all that work has barely made a dent in their insurance bills. Should they be getting a bigger break?

wire.title: Doctors struggle to save babies after parents refuse vitamin K
wire.summary: Doctors are fighting an uphill battle against disinformation about routine vitamin K shots given to newborns in the hospital. It helps prevent a rare but devastating bleeding disorder.

wire.title: They attended Trump's meme coin dinner.  It didn't go well
wire.summary: Trump's meme coin dinners have sparked intense controversy. These two guests attended his latest on Sunday — and agreed to provide NPR inside access.

wire.title: Black travelers on Route 66 weren't welcome at most gas stations — except this one
wire.summary: Threatt Filling Station in Luther, Okla., was the first Black-owned gas station on Route 66. At a time when Black families needed the Green Book to find places to stay, eat, use the bathroom, it provided fuel and respite.

wire.title: For workplace culture champions, Jensen Huang's return is 'unfathomable'
wire.summary: Some who have worked to promote diversity and inclusion in Silicon Valley say Jensen Huang's reinstatement as Nvidia's CEO sends a message that all that matters is money.

wire.title: Democrats probe whether Trump Jr.-aligned businesses benefit from government access
wire.summary: Investigators say companies with ties to Donald Trump Jr's investment firm, 1789 Capital, have profited since his father's reelection.

wire.title: US attorney general dodges questions about Nvidia investigation
wire.summary: Nvidia's share price have fallen 7% as lawmakers demand answers about President Donald Trump's involvement in Huang's reinstatement.

wire.title: French ex-President Sarkozy and wife Carla Bruni to face trial
wire.summary: It is the latest case involving Nicolas Sarkozy who became the first French ex-president to go to jail last year.

wire.title: Indian government has 'lost the plot', says 'cockroach' leader barred from UK flight
wire.summary: Saurav Das says immigration authorities at Delhi airport told him his passport had been flagged.

wire.title: Huawei found guilty of stealing trade secrets but acquitted of racketeering
wire.summary: The verdict follows a months-long trial in New York.

wire.title: Land mine casualties soar in Syria, two years after war
wire.summary: Nearly 1,000 children are among those killed or injured by explosives left over from the conflict, figures show.

wire.title: Nigerian monarch, 92, suspended after sexual assault claims
wire.summary: The Emir of Daura is one of Nigeria's best-known monarchs, with politicians often trying to gain his support.
